t: A Single-File Local Web Framework, Powered by Python + Nix + HTMX + a Built-In LLM
s: A local-first web framework built in Python, leveraging Nix for declarative builds, HTMX for dynamic UI, and a local LLM for extensibility. It prioritizes single-file simplicity and full transparency, avoiding traditional enterprise architecture complexities.
sub: Local-first web framework architecture (Python, Nix, HTMX, FastHTML)
LLM integration for code generation, plugin creation, and operational tasks
Comparison to Electron apps and differentiation from traditional web apps
Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) deployment with Nix Flakes for local environments
